resolution_summary: Worker-2 recovered source-supported Table 1 activity rows, worker-4 source-verified APD6 AP02646, and worker-6 replaced the framework-test review with source-reviewed accepted-with-cautions adjudication.

remaining_cautions.evidence_context: Table 1 values are inhibition-zone diameters produced by S. suis 65 spots. They are not MIC/MBC values and not purified suicin 65 dose-response values.
APD6 AP02646 supports Anti-Gram+ activity and inhibition-zone context but has no assay-specific MIC/MBC fields.
Primary sources support structure, stability, and phenotypic inhibition; direct molecular killing mechanism is not assayed for suicin 65.
No hemolysis/cytotoxicity assay is reported in the local paper/package; no toxicity value is fabricated.
